body:
Whilst this change feels a bit out there, I believe it is worth it.
Looks good to me on all fronts!

Maybe some trick using the `using` keyword could be used to make the change less noisy for files that include `resource_uid.h`. Something like this:
```
using ID = ResourceUIDTypes::ID;
using INVALID_ID = ResourceUIDTypes::INVALID_ID;
```
added to `resource_uid.h` would do the trick. Not necessary though.
